_note: DRAFT guide figures for variant Sections 2 & 3 - review before launch. Used/recon bands, labour hours and problem costs are per engine family. The Rebuilt row is computed from each variant's own 'rebuild from' price (Sec3 cards).

problems.title: Timing Belt Failure
problems.symptoms: Ticking from the front cover, loss of power, sudden engine stoppage.
problems.urgencyNote: belt failure can cause catastrophic engine damage.
problems.recommendation: Replace every 60,000 miles or 5 years. Always use an OEM or quality equivalent belt kit.

problems.title: Head Gasket Failure
problems.symptoms: Coolant loss, white smoke, bubbling in the expansion tank.
problems.urgencyNote: can lead to overheating and further damage.
problems.recommendation: Use the correct torque sequence and a quality gasket. Check the head for cracks while it is off.

problems.title: Injection Pump Wear
problems.symptoms: Hard starting, loss of power, smoke under load.
problems.urgencyNote: affects drivability and can cause further wear.
problems.recommendation: Use quality diesel and change the fuel filter regularly. Have pump timing checked if starting issues occur.

problems.title: Timing Belt Failure
problems.symptoms: Rattle from the timing cover, oil on the belt, sudden loss of power.
problems.urgencyNote: a snapped belt can bend valves and destroy the engine.
problems.recommendation: Replace the belt, tensioner and cover backplate together every 60,000 miles or 5 years.

problems.title: Head Gasket Failure
problems.symptoms: Coolant loss, pressurised hoses, white exhaust smoke.
problems.urgencyNote: repeated overheating can crack the head.
problems.recommendation: Keep the cooling system healthy (radiator, viscous fan, hoses) and pressure-test the head when it is off.

problems.title: Injection Pump Wear
problems.symptoms: Diesel leaks around the pump, hard hot starting, poor idle.
problems.urgencyNote: leaks and poor running worsen over time.
problems.recommendation: Reseal the pump at the first sign of a leak and keep the fuel filter changed on schedule.

problems.title: Injector Loom Oil Leak
problems.symptoms: Misfires, limp mode, oil in the injector harness plug.
problems.urgencyNote: oil can travel down the loom into the ECU.
problems.recommendation: Replace the injector loom and injector seals together, and fit an oil-stop lead to protect the ECU.

problems.title: Cylinder Head Cracking
problems.symptoms: Unexplained coolant loss, mayonnaise under the oil cap, overheating.
problems.urgencyNote: coolant in the oil quickly destroys bearings.
problems.recommendation: Pressure-test the head at the first sign of coolant loss and never keep driving an overheating Td5.

problems.title: Oil Pump Bolt Failure
problems.symptoms: Sudden low oil pressure warning, knocking, engine seizure.
problems.urgencyNote: loss of oil pressure can seize the engine.
problems.recommendation: Have the oil pump bolt checked and secured with the updated fix during any sump-off work.

problems.title: Turbocharger Failure
problems.symptoms: Whistling, blue smoke, loss of boost, limp mode.
problems.urgencyNote: a failing turbo can ingest debris into the engine.
problems.recommendation: Change oil on time with the correct spec and let the engine idle before switching off after hard driving.

problems.title: EGR & Intake Carbon Build-Up
problems.symptoms: Rough running, smoke, poor economy, EGR fault codes.
problems.urgencyNote: restricts airflow and can damage the turbo.
problems.recommendation: Have the inlet and EGR cleaned during major services and avoid constant short journeys.

problems.title: Timing Chain Wear
problems.symptoms: Rattle on cold start, timing correlation fault codes.
problems.urgencyNote: a stretched chain can jump timing.
problems.recommendation: Investigate any cold-start rattle early - replacing the chain kit is far cheaper than an engine.

problems.title: Head Gasket Failure
problems.symptoms: Coolant loss, overheating, mayonnaise under the oil cap.
problems.urgencyNote: the K-Series is intolerant of any overheating.
problems.recommendation: Fit a multi-layer steel gasket, steel dowels and an uprated thermostat - never ignore coolant loss.

problems.title: Coolant Loss & Overheating
problems.symptoms: Temperature gauge climbing, steam, sweet smell from the bay.
problems.urgencyNote: overheating is the main cause of K-Series failure.
problems.recommendation: Check coolant level weekly and replace the pump and thermostat with the timing belt.

problems.title: Timing Belt Failure
problems.symptoms: Engine cuts out and will not restart, rattling at the front.
problems.urgencyNote: belt failure causes valve damage.
problems.recommendation: Replace the belt and tensioner every 60,000 miles or 5 years.

problems.title: Coolant Loss & Overheating
problems.symptoms: Coolant loss, overheating in traffic, steam from the bay.
problems.urgencyNote: overheating quickly damages the heads.
problems.recommendation: Replace perished coolant pipes and the expansion tank cap, and keep the system pressure-tested.

problems.title: Timing Belt Failure
problems.symptoms: Rattle from the belts, sudden stall, will not restart.
problems.urgencyNote: an interference engine - a broken belt bends valves.
problems.recommendation: Replace both belts, tensioners and idlers together at the scheduled interval.

problems.title: Head Gasket Failure
problems.symptoms: White smoke, coolant in the oil, misfires.
problems.urgencyNote: usually follows a cooling-system fault.
problems.recommendation: Fix cooling leaks immediately and have both heads skimmed and checked if one gasket has failed.

problems.title: Liner Slip & Cracked Liners
problems.symptoms: Coolant loss, pressurised hoses, misfire on one bank.
problems.urgencyNote: a slipped liner means the block must be re-sleeved.
problems.recommendation: Fit top-hat liners during a rebuild and keep the cooling system in perfect order.

problems.title: Overheating
problems.symptoms: Gauge climbing when towing or in traffic, coolant loss.
problems.urgencyNote: overheating is the leading cause of liner failure.
problems.recommendation: Flush or replace the radiator and check the viscous fan coupling regularly.

problems.title: Oil Leaks
problems.symptoms: Oil smell, drips under the gearbox, smoke from the manifolds.
problems.urgencyNote: mostly a nuisance, but watch the oil level.
problems.recommendation: Renew rocker cover gaskets and the rear main seal during any engine-out work.

problems.title: Water Pump & Coolant Leaks
problems.symptoms: Coolant loss, sweet smell, overheating warnings.
problems.urgencyNote: overheating can warp the heads.
problems.recommendation: Replace the water pump and coolant pipes at the first sign of leakage.

problems.title: Supercharger Isolator Wear
problems.symptoms: Rattle at idle that fades with revs.
problems.urgencyNote: noisy but rarely damaging if fixed promptly.
problems.recommendation: Replace the isolator coupler when the rattle first appears.

problems.title: Timing Chain & Tensioner Wear
problems.symptoms: Cold-start rattle, timing fault codes.
problems.urgencyNote: a slipped chain can destroy the engine.
problems.recommendation: Use the correct oil specification and investigate any start-up rattle early.

problems.title: Crankshaft & Bearing Failure
problems.symptoms: Knocking, low oil pressure, sudden engine stoppage.
problems.urgencyNote: the most common cause of TDV6/SDV6 engine loss.
problems.recommendation: Shorten oil-change intervals to 8,000–10,000 miles and act immediately on any knock.

problems.title: Timing & Fuel Pump Belt Wear
problems.symptoms: Whine from the belts, rough running, sudden stall.
problems.urgencyNote: belt failure causes major valve damage.
problems.recommendation: Replace both belts, tensioners and the water pump at the scheduled interval.

problems.title: Turbo Failure
problems.symptoms: Limp mode, loss of boost, oil in the intercooler pipes.
problems.urgencyNote: debris from a failed turbo can enter the engine.
problems.recommendation: Check the turbo actuator and oil feed lines whenever boost faults appear.

problems.title: Turbocharger Failure
problems.symptoms: Whistle, smoke, loss of power, limp mode.
problems.urgencyNote: turbo debris can damage the engine.
problems.recommendation: Keep oil changes frequent and fix boost leaks promptly.

problems.title: Oil Cooler & Coolant Leaks
problems.symptoms: Coolant loss, oil mixing with coolant, overheating.
problems.urgencyNote: cross-contamination quickly damages bearings.
problems.recommendation: Investigate any coolant loss straight away and replace the oil cooler seals.

problems.title: Bearing Wear & Crank Damage
problems.symptoms: Knocking, low oil pressure warning.
problems.urgencyNote: continued driving destroys the crankshaft.
problems.recommendation: Use the correct oil spec, shorten oil-change intervals and stop at the first knock.

problems.title: DPF Blockage
problems.symptoms: DPF warning light, limp mode, rising oil level.
problems.urgencyNote: repeated failed regens dilute the oil.
problems.recommendation: Use regular motorway runs and low-ash oil, and have the DPF cleaned before it fully blocks.

problems.title: Timing Belt Failure
problems.symptoms: Squeal from the front, sudden stall, will not restart.
problems.urgencyNote: belt failure causes valve damage.
problems.recommendation: Replace the belt, tensioner and water pump together at the scheduled interval.

problems.title: Crank Pulley Failure
problems.symptoms: Vibration, knocking from the front, auxiliary belt misalignment.
problems.urgencyNote: a failed pulley can take out the timing belt.
problems.recommendation: Replace the crank pulley with the timing belt as preventative work.

problems.title: Coolant Loss & Overheating
problems.symptoms: Low coolant warning, overheating, sweet smell.
problems.urgencyNote: overheating can damage the head and gasket.
problems.recommendation: Investigate any coolant loss immediately and keep the system pressure-tested.

problems.title: Turbo Wastegate Rattle
problems.symptoms: Rattle on deceleration, boost faults, loss of power.
problems.urgencyNote: mostly noise, but can worsen to boost loss.
problems.recommendation: Have the wastegate linkage checked when the rattle first appears.

problems.title: Carbon Build-Up
problems.symptoms: Rough idle, misfires, poor economy.
problems.urgencyNote: gradual loss of performance.
problems.recommendation: Use quality fuel and have the intake valves cleaned if misfires develop.

problems.title: Timing Chain Stretch
problems.symptoms: Rattle on start-up, timing correlation codes, engine warning light.
problems.urgencyNote: a jumped chain causes catastrophic valve damage.
problems.recommendation: Use the correct low-SAPS oil, shorten oil changes and investigate any start-up rattle immediately.

problems.title: DPF & EGR Clogging
problems.symptoms: DPF warning, rising oil level, limp mode.
problems.urgencyNote: diluted oil accelerates chain and bearing wear.
problems.recommendation: Give the car regular longer runs and check the oil level for dilution between services.

problems.title: Bearing Wear
problems.symptoms: Knocking, low oil pressure warning.
problems.urgencyNote: continued driving destroys the crankshaft.
problems.recommendation: Stop driving at the first knock - early action often means a rebuild rather than a replacement.

problems.title: Timing Chain Stretch
problems.symptoms: Rattle on start-up, timing fault codes, rough idle.
problems.urgencyNote: a jumped chain causes major engine damage.
problems.recommendation: Keep to the correct oil spec, shorten oil changes and check any start-up rattle early.

problems.title: Water Pump & Coolant Leaks
problems.symptoms: Low coolant warning, coolant smell, overheating.
problems.urgencyNote: overheating risks head gasket damage.
problems.recommendation: Top up only with the correct coolant and investigate any repeated loss.

problems.title: Turbo & Wastegate Faults
problems.symptoms: Loss of power, boost fault codes, rattling on overrun.
problems.urgencyNote: drivability issue that can worsen.
problems.recommendation: Diagnose boost faults early - many are actuator issues rather than a full turbo failure.

problems.title: Cooling System Faults
problems.symptoms: Coolant warnings, reduced EV range, overheating alerts.
problems.urgencyNote: the hybrid system limits power to protect itself.
problems.recommendation: Have cooling warnings diagnosed promptly by a hybrid-trained specialist.

problems.title: Misfire & Ignition Faults
problems.symptoms: Juddering under load, engine warning light.
problems.urgencyNote: can damage the catalytic converter if ignored.
problems.recommendation: Replace plugs on schedule and fix misfires quickly.

problems.title: Hybrid System Faults
problems.symptoms: Hybrid system warnings, engine running unexpectedly, no EV mode.
problems.urgencyNote: may mask a genuine engine fault.
problems.recommendation: Get a full diagnostic before agreeing to any engine work.

problems.title: DPF & EGR Clogging
problems.symptoms: DPF warning, rising oil level, reduced power.
problems.urgencyNote: diluted oil accelerates internal wear.
problems.recommendation: Allow regular longer runs for regeneration and check the oil level between services.

problems.title: Timing Chain Wear
problems.symptoms: Start-up rattle, timing correlation fault codes.
problems.urgencyNote: chain failure causes major valve damage.
problems.recommendation: Use the correct oil spec and have any start-up rattle investigated straight away.

problems.title: Bearing Wear
problems.symptoms: Knocking, low oil pressure warning.
problems.urgencyNote: continued driving destroys the crankshaft.
problems.recommendation: Stop at the first knock - an early rebuild costs far less than a replacement engine.

problems.title: Timing Chain Wear
problems.symptoms: Start-up rattle, timing fault codes.
problems.urgencyNote: chain failure causes major engine damage.
problems.recommendation: Use the correct oil spec and investigate any rattle immediately.

problems.title: 48V Mild-Hybrid & eSupercharger Faults
problems.symptoms: Hybrid warnings, hesitation, stop-start not working.
problems.urgencyNote: can mimic engine faults.
problems.recommendation: Get a full diagnostic before agreeing to any engine work.

problems.title: Coolant Leaks
problems.symptoms: Low coolant warning, sweet smell, overheating.
problems.urgencyNote: overheating risks head damage.
problems.recommendation: Fix coolant leaks promptly and use only the specified coolant.

problems.title: Timing Chain Tensioner Failure
problems.symptoms: Rattle on cold start, timing fault codes.
problems.urgencyNote: a jumped chain destroys the engine.
problems.recommendation: Fit the updated tensioners and guides at the first sign of start-up rattle.

problems.title: Water Pump Failure
problems.symptoms: Coolant loss, overheating, whine from the front.
problems.urgencyNote: overheating can warp the heads.
problems.recommendation: Replace the water pump preventatively and check coolant pipes at every service.

problems.title: Supercharger Isolator Wear
problems.symptoms: Rattle at idle that fades with revs.
problems.urgencyNote: noisy but rarely damaging if fixed promptly.
problems.recommendation: Replace the isolator coupler when the rattle first appears.

problems.title: High Oil Consumption
problems.symptoms: Blue smoke on start-up, frequent top-ups, oily plugs.
problems.urgencyNote: low oil levels quickly damage the turbos and bearings.
problems.recommendation: Check the oil level weekly and shorten oil-change intervals.

problems.title: Timing Chain Stretch
problems.symptoms: Rattle on start-up, rough running, timing fault codes.
problems.urgencyNote: chain failure causes major engine damage.
problems.recommendation: Use the correct oil spec and investigate any start-up noise early.

problems.title: Hot-Vee Turbo & Coolant Leaks
problems.symptoms: Coolant loss, oil leaks, burning smell, boost faults.
problems.urgencyNote: heat in the V accelerates seal and hose failure.
problems.recommendation: Have the hot-vee area inspected at every service and replace perished hoses early.

problems.title: Hot-Vee Turbo & Hose Wear
problems.symptoms: Coolant or oil leaks, burning smell, boost faults.
problems.urgencyNote: heat in the V accelerates hose and seal wear.
problems.recommendation: Have the hot-vee area inspected at every service.

problems.title: 48V Mild-Hybrid Faults
problems.symptoms: Hybrid warnings, stop-start faults, hesitation.
problems.urgencyNote: can mimic engine faults.
problems.recommendation: Get a full diagnostic before agreeing to any engine work.

problems.title: Oil Quality & Service Neglect
problems.symptoms: Rising oil consumption, warning lights, rough running.
problems.urgencyNote: neglect is the main risk on a newer engine.
problems.recommendation: Use the specified oil and consider shorter oil-change intervals than the maximum.
